checks: Completed native graph receipts, manifest, seals, cold/reload parity, complete 8397-column initializer and full cache hash are required before CG.
Genuine clean fedf4214 model_code working directory and original scientific command are preserved; authentic parent357 inheritance is explicit and old k19 resume is forbidden.
Native license preflight has a 120-second timeout and precedes CG graph loading; failure records evidence without starting CG.
Exclusive root STARTED.json at worker line 112 prevents a second fresh job ID from starting; requeue attempts fail closed before that seal.
Unique attempt directories, process failure evidence and atomic native pool checkpoints are preserved; no MIP, successor, source-pin mutation or automatic resubmission is present.

Manifest and exact sbatch argv agree on 8 CPUs, 16 GiB, five hours, default partition, Scaglione account, requeue and exclusion of scaglione-compute-01; native CG allowance is 14400 seconds with a 17400-second subprocess cap.

The sbatch wrap command invokes the exact deployment-root worker with the reviewed manifest SHA256; deployment_plan binds both deployed file hashes and the reviewed sbatch argv hash. Logs use the new deployment root.

coverage: resealed route and initializer parity drift rejection
scientific flags and genuine parent preservation
requeue and duplicate fresh job rejection

limitations: Review is local and does not establish current cluster access, resource policy, deployment hashes or effective scheduler allocation; the deployment plan requires those checks before or at submission.
The native CG allowance remains soft because LP solves and initialization have no internal deadline; the outer process cap bounds the solver subprocess.
The 16 GiB allocation preserves headroom above the measured graph-reload peak but does not prove the memory ceiling of a growing CG master and route pool.
A failed first attempt retains STARTED.json and therefore requires explicit reviewed recovery, even when failure occurs before CG starts.
